summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change moved payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable; the worker processed orders without payment. Worker thread stalled (heartbeat 103s old) with a growing queue backlog (456); the cause is unknown, and a restart cleared it.
recommended: Check with ops that payments-v2 is reachable before retrying the migration.
Find out why the worker stalled.
Alert on provider call failures, which are logged only at DEBUG.

events.text:
version: v1.3
payment_provider_url: internal://payments-v2
queue_max: 1000
worker_count: 1
sync_interval_s: 5
Fix the config first (the queue is still draining without payment).
payment_provider_url: 'internal://payments-v2' -> 'internal://payments-v1'. Confirmed: the service is now using the new value.

Still broken:
- [business] worker_stalled: Worker heartbeat is 103s old (queue depth 456).
- [business] queue_backlog: Queue depth 456 and growing (was 447).
Worker stalled; the config is now fixed, so restarting is safe.
All business invariants green (health, payments, queue, worker, ledger, errors, latency).

args.summary: The ops change to payments-v2 made the payment provider unreachable, so 20 orders were processed unpaid. I reverted the URL to payments-v1 and reprocessed all 20. The worker had stalled with a backlog of 456, so I restarted it, and all invariants are now green. Why the worker stalled is still unknown.
